title: Internationaler Tag des Strickens in der Öffentlichkeit
description:

issues: Location field contains label 'Veranstaltungsort:' and extra whitespace, not a clean extraction.
Description is auto-generated from other fields (title, location, time, organizer) and lacks original informative content.
Missing district tag – one of the available districts should be included; only 'Handwerk' is present.

_quality.summary: Event entry has a clear title and time extraction, but location extraction is cluttered (includes label), description is a redundant auto-generation, and no district tag is assigned. Overall quality is moderate but has notable deficiencies.
